episodes.title: Chapitre un - Les origines
episodes.summary: Madeleine recounts her nightmarish visions to Élise. An unsettling truth rears its head during an encounter between Joseph and Oka, a prisoner.

episodes.title: Chapitre deux - Le revenant
episodes.summary: Someone unexpectedly reaches out to Élise through Madeleine. Joseph begins to dissect the mystery behind Rebecca's death.

episodes.title: Chapitre trois - Les innocents
episodes.summary: The Brotherhood convinces Joseph to help them infiltrate the prison. Ophélie coerces Father Maxence into divulging details on the man in Élise's locket.

episodes.title: Chapitre quatre - Les bourreaux
episodes.summary: With his newfound abilities as a blue-blood, Donatien tracks down Guy de Montargis, who makes a searing confession. Albert faces a tragic dilemma.

episodes.title: Chapitre cinq - Le sang bleu
episodes.summary: As the origin of the blue blood comes to light, Élise must form an alliance between nobles and rebels to avert its spread.

episodes.title: Chapitre six - L'alliance
episodes.summary: Joseph and Katell fall prey to Donatien's sinister scheme. Charles orders Pérouse to track down Élise and Lariboise.

episodes.title: Chapitre sept - Le dilemme
episodes.summary: As Joseph continues his search for a cure, tensions come to a head between Charles and Donatien, and Madeleine defies Donatien's attempt to destroy her.

episodes.title: Chapitre huit - La révolte
episodes.summary: Ophélie glimpses into Madeleine's alarming power, Oka and Albert part ways, and Élise faces betrayal.
